content.text: In Zimbabwe, even with global market access, Stripe still can't be used for digital product sales. The exact same issue plagues digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. This isn't a problem that's going to magically fix itself, and neither is it one that can be bypassed with workarounds or hacks. The solution is to own the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-explained-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-digital-products-africa-stripe|infrastructure]], to build a digital commerce stack from the ground up, and to never rely on platforms again. That's where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-3|Cloudflare Workers]] R2 comes in – a cloud storage solution that allows you to host and deliver digital products without any platform fees or restrictions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a secure, scalable, and highly available object storage solution that's designed to handle large volumes of data and high traffic. It's the perfect fit for hosting and delivering digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. With R2, you can store your digital products in a central location and then deliver them to your customers instantly. This is a game-changer for digital creators who want to sell their products without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip that charge hefty fees – up to 10% on every sale. Cloudflare R2, on the other hand, offers a flat rate of $0.02 per 1,000 requests, making it a much more cost-effective option in the long run.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here's how the architecture works under the hood: Cloudflare R2 stores your digital products as objects in a bucket, and then Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script fetches the objects and delivers them to your customers in real-time. This is a seamless process that happens behind the scenes, and it's what makes it possible to deliver digital products without any platform fees or restrictions. The beauty of this architecture is that it's fully customizable, so you can tailor it to your specific needs and requirements.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who want to sell their products without relying on platforms that charge hefty fees. It's perfect for those who want to maintain full control over their digital products and their customer data. With Cloudflare R2, you can store and deliver your digital products in a way that's fast, secure, and cost-effective. This is especially important for creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or severely restricted.
By using Cloudflare R2, you can save up to 10% on every sale compared to using platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this solution work together are Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, which handles the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This is a complete digital commerce stack that's designed to handle everything from storage to delivery to payment processing. With this stack, you can sell your digital products without relying on platforms, and you can do it all from the ground up.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy today, start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. This kit will give you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Next, head over to the Shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack, which includes Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. Follow the deployment guide to set up your digital commerce stack, and start selling your digital products without relying on platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Cloudflare R2 offers a flat rate of $0.02 per 1,000 requests, making it a much more cost-effective option in the long run.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
